
# Implementation Plan: Improve Testing

**Branch**: `003-improve-testing-go` | **Date**: 2025-10-11 | **Spec**: [spec.md](./spec.md)
**Input**: Feature specification from `/specs/003-improve-testing-go/spec.md`

**Note**: This plan is generated by `/speckit.plan` for the Improve Testing feature.

## Summary

Primary requirement: Achieve at least 75% unit test coverage across all Python files, with at least one unit test per function (including off-nominal/failure cases), and ensure BDD tests cover all major user workflows (clone, branch, commit, pull, merge, push) with multi-repo and multi-branch support. Technical approach: Use pytest for unit tests (with mocks for isolation), Behave for BDD, and enforce coverage via CI. No merge conflicts are intentionally created in workflow tests.


## Technical Context

**Language/Version**: Python 3.12+
**Primary Dependencies**: Flask, gitpython, pydantic, pytest, Behave, uv, ruff
**Storage**: Filesystem (user data in separate directories/namespaces)
**Testing**: pytest (unit), Behave (BDD)
**Target Platform**: Linux server
**Project Type**: Single project (backend REST API)
**Performance Goals**: 75%+ code coverage by unit tests; all major workflows pass BDD
**Constraints**: No intentional merge conflicts in workflow tests; test isolation via mocks
**Scale/Scope**: Multiple repositories and branches per user; support for concurrent users
